entries.text: On the first night the hand lifted the fallen branch from the cave mouth, and we ran in out of the rain.
On the first day the hand lifted Ona for the first time. She did not fall.
On the first night the storm drove two of us to the cave: Ona and Tuk. The hand looked down and called us by our names.
On the second day we lit our first fire, and the hand watched over it.
On the second day the hand grew: Grip II. Lift 3 people; unlocks the scoop gesture. Granted free as the first gift.
On the fifth day Ruk walked into the valley and stayed with us. We were no longer alone.
On the fifth day the way to the valley floor opened, and we went to look.
On the fifth day Kesh came to live with us.
On the fifth day Lema came to live with us.
On the sixth day we set stones in a ring around the fire, and sat together inside it.
On the sixth day we finished our first hut. That night we slept dry.
On the sixth day our dream came true: "A shelter of our own, and a ring of stones for our fire."
On the sixth day the hand grew: Strength I. Lift weight 4 (fallen logs).
On the sixth day the way to the western meadow opened, and we went to look.
On the sixth day Lok came to live with us.
On the sixth day Zuri came to live with us.
On the sixth day Sten came to live with us.
On the sixth day Kesi came to live with us.
On the sixth day Rin was born to Ona and Tuk, the first child of the valley.
On the eighth day we raised a shrine to the hand, and knelt there.
On the ninth day the hand grew: Warmth. Hold over people or a fire to warm them.
On the tenth day we built a rack to dry meat and berries.
On the tenth day we built a store for our food.
On the tenth day Daro was born to Lema and Kesh.
On the tenth day Lio was born to Zuri and Lok.
We lived through our first winter. Twelve of us saw the spring.
On the twelfth day our dream came true: "A shrine to the hand, so we can speak to you."
On the thirteenth day the hand grew: Blessing. People you set down work 2x for 30 s.
On the sixteenth day Tor was born to Ona and Tuk.
On the sixteenth day the great stones stood in their circle at last.
On the sixteenth day Ilo was born to Kesi and Ruk.
On the nineteenth day Ilka was born to Rin and Sten.
On the nineteenth day Tam was born to Lema and Kesh.
On the twentieth day Zev was born to Zuri and Lok.
On the twenty-third day our dream came true: "A circle of stones that points at the sky, where all of us can stand."
On the twenty-fourth day the Age of the Village began.
On the twenty-fourth day Ivo came to live with us.
On the twenty-fourth day Hilde came to live with us.
On the twenty-fourth day Hector was born to Rin and Sten.
On the twenty-fourth day Elin was born to Kesi and Ruk.
On the twenty-fourth day Sigrun was born to Zuri and Lok.
On the twenty-fourth day we finished the field.
On the twenty-fourth day Edric was born to Hilde and Ivo.
On the twenty-sixth day the hand grew: Reach. Place people across the great river.
On the twenty-sixth day the way to the east bank opened, and we went to look.
On the twenty-sixth day Bram came to live with us.
On the twenty-sixth day Edda came to live with us.
On the twenty-sixth day Matti came to live with us.
On the twenty-sixth day we finished the granary.
On the twenty-sixth day we finished the cottage.

On the twenty-seventh day we finished the mill.

memories.text: The hand brought us the log for our first fire.
The hand picked up our handprint stone, and its grip grew.
With the hand's help we made our dream come true: a shelter of our own, and a ring of stones for our fire
Four of us hunted together for the first time, and the hand carried us there.
We sewed clothes from the hides of the hunt, and the winter bit less.
We lived through winter number 1.
With the hand's help we made our dream come true: a shrine to the hand, so we can speak to you
The hand learned to bless us.
The hand blessed us and we danced at the fire all night. Our first festival.
Blessed by the hand, our hunters brought down the great elk.
We learned to make stone tools. Now we gather faster, and we can fell trees.
We lived through winter number 2.
With the hand's help we made our dream come true: a circle of stones that points at the sky, where all of us can stand
We rebuilt our huts as cottages, with stone footings and room for a family
We painted the hand over our doors, so it knows our houses.
We stood on the river bank and looked across. Clay, and green stone in the rocks. We wanted the far bank.
We built a granary. The grain is safe from the damp and the mice.
We fired pots in the kiln. Now we can keep more of everything.
The fields gave and gave. We danced among the sheaves at the harvest festival, and thanked the hand.
We lived through winter number 3.
With the hand's help we made our dream come true: a granary, so we never go hungry in winter
Five of us pushed the raft into the great river, and now we fish from boats.
We wove wool into cloth and made warm clothes. The winter bites less.
Our first market day. Traders came down the valley, and some of them stayed.
We raised the great bridge. Now the far bank is a walk away, and everyone sleeps at home.
With the hand's help we made our dream come true: a bridge over the great river, so we can walk home at night
The hand rolled the rockfall aside, and the hill quarry opened to us
We lived through winter number 4.
We lived through winter number 5.
We raised the Temple of the Hand where the old shrine stood, and painted the hand on its doors.
With the hand's help we made our dream come true: a temple for the hand, with our hand painted on its doors
We lived through winter number 6.
